weekLabel: Week of Aug 20 to Aug 27 · refreshed Thursday Aug 20. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.name: Riverfest at Salisbury Beach
events.meta: Free · Broadway Boardwalk, Salisbury Beach · 24th annual, run by 92.5 The River. Spin Doctors headline at 4:30, Buffalo Tom at 3:00, Fantastic Cat and Gavin Marengi earlier. Free live music on the sand all afternoon, then fireworks over the water at 10:15. Special event parking runs $40 until 6pm, so go early or park off the boardwalk and walk in. source

events.when: Fri Aug 21 4pm, Sat Aug 22 12pm, Sun Aug 23
events.name: San Gennaro Feast
events.meta: Free entry · North End, Boston (confirm exact block on the official site) · Classic North End street feast: food vendors, live entertainment and processions across the weekend. Take the Orange Line to Haymarket, North End parking is a losing game. source

events.name: Patriots preseason vs Eagles
events.meta: Ticketed · Gillette Stadium, 1 Patriot Place, Foxborough · Final home preseason game before the season opens. One for Dave and Alex. source

events.name: Revolution vs New York City FC
events.meta: Ticketed, parking is free · Gillette Stadium, 1 Patriot Place, Foxborough · Lots open 2:30, gates 3:30. Cheaper and easier than the NFL, and Patriot Place gives you somewhere to eat before kickoff. source

events.name: 43rd Annual Seacoast Jazz Festival
events.meta: Free, $20 suggested donation · Prescott Park, 105 Marcy St, Portsmouth NH · All-afternoon waterfront jazz on the Wilcox Main Stage: Yoko Miwa Trio, Soggy Po' Boys, Salsa Secrets and the Seacoast Big Band. Rain date Sun Aug 23. Pair it with a walk through Portsmouth and food on the water. source

events.name: SoWa Open Market
events.meta: Free entry · 500 Harrison Ave, Boston · The standing city Sunday: 100+ makers, farmers market, food trucks, vintage. Easy to walk to a coffee or juice stop first. source

events.name: St. Anthony's Feast
events.meta: Free · Endicott, Thatcher and North Margin Streets, North End · 107th year and the biggest Italian feast in New England. The 10-hour Grand Procession runs Sunday Aug 30 from 11:30am on Endicott St. No tickets exist, anyone selling them is a scam. source

events.name: Boston Caribbean Carnival
events.meta: Free to watch · Grand Parade from Roxbury through Dorchester to Franklin Park, festival at Playstead Park · One of the Northeast's biggest Caribbean celebrations: feathered mas bands, soca and steel pan. Big crowds, go early and plan the T. source

events.name: Langhorne Slim at Prescott Park
events.meta: $20 suggested donation · Prescott Park, 105 Marcy St, Portsmouth NH · Waterfront outdoor show, blankets on the grass. Reserve a table ahead if you want a real patch of lawn. source

events.name: Topsfield Fair
events.meta: Ticketed (price verify) · 207 Boston St, Topsfield · America's oldest county fair, 30 minutes away. Buy online ahead and go on a weekday if you can. source
